subject: Error running models with adjacent areas with disjunct distributions

messages.author: a65abcf2d8c47b08
messages.subject: Error running models with adjacent areas with disjunct distributions
parts:
Hi there, everyone, hope you are well.

A colleague of mine is trying to run models in BioGeoBEARS that include the area adjacent matrix. However, whenever she tries to run the model, it gives the following error:

Error in tipranges_to_tip_condlikes_of_data_on_each_state(tipranges, phy, : 
STOP ERROR in tipranges_to_tip_condlikes_of_data_on_each_state(): 

Your geography file has a tip range which is not allowed in your specified state space (states_list). 

The tip is: Liolaemus_lentus 
The 0-based areas in the range is/are: '4_5_6' 
The letter codes in the range are: 'E_F_G 

Try editing either the geography file, the areas allowed or areas_adjacency matrices, or the states_list (non-stratified) / lists_of_states_lists_Obased (stratified).

The tip that it is referring has a disjunct disribution (and is the only specie that has it). The image bellow shows the distribution of the specie. Can a model with an adjacent areas' matrix run when there is a specie with this distribution? How can we fix this error?



Cheers.
Matheus Pontes Nogueira

messages.subject: Re: [BioGeoBEARS] Error running models with adjacent areas with disjunct distributions
parts:
Hi -- please see:

Manually modifying the list of states/ranges — A BETTER SOLUTION than the areas-adjacency matrix
http://phylo.wikidot.com/biogeobears#better_than_adjacency
Cheers!
Nick
